name: BigOBench
intro: BigOBench 是一个新颖的编程基准，用于评估生成式语言模型理解和生成满足时间与空间复杂度约束代码的能力。它弥补了现有评测忽视计算复杂度理解的空白。该基准提供工具，通过性能分析推断任意Python函数的算法复杂度，包括人类或模型生成的代码。
build_method: Code Contests正确解筛选, 输入扩展, 沙箱性能剖析, 非负最小二乘拟合, 人工复杂度验证
metric: Pass@k, Best@k, All@k, Coefficient Percentile Ranking
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.15242: BigO(Bench) starts from correct Python Code Contests solutions, filters problems and solutions, expands inputs, profiles runtime and memory over many input sizes, uses non-negative least-squares curve fitting and a simplicity bias to infer time and space complexity labels plus coefficients, releases 3,105 problems and 1,190,250 annotated solutions with runtime/memory measurements, builds time and space test sets, and evaluates complexity prediction, constrained code generation, and coefficient-based ranking with Pass@k, Best@k, and All@k metrics.
build_method_en: Correct Code Contests Solution Filtering, Input Expansion, Sandbox Profiling, Non-negative Least-squares Fitting, Human Complexity Validation
eval_feature_en: Measured Time and Space Complexity, Constraint-aware Generation
intro_en: BigOBench is a novel programming benchmark designed to evaluate generative language models' ability to understand and generate code that meets time and space complexity constraints. It addresses the gap in existing evaluations that overlook computational complexity understanding. The benchmark provides tools to infer the algorithmic complexity of any Python function through performance analysis, applicable to both human- and model-generated code.
metric_en: Pass@k, Best@k, All@k, Coefficient Percentile Ranking
